scripts.py:ensure: UV_CACHE_DIR=../../.uv-cache uv venv --python "$(command -v python3)" --allow-existing .venv && (.venv/bin/python -c "import model_gateway" >/dev/null 2>&1 || UV_CACHE_DIR=../../.uv-cache uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .)
scripts.py:install: UV_CACHE_DIR=../../.uv-cache uv venv --python "$(command -v python3)" --clear .venv && UV_CACHE_DIR=../../.uv-cache uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
scripts.test: pnpm run py:ensure && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
scripts.lint: pnpm run py:ensure && .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q src/model_gateway tests
